subject: CloudHarbor vendor onboarding: PO intake, remittance, and early-pay enrollment
messages:
From: Megan Liu <megan.liu@cloudharbor.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudHarbor AP <ap@cloudharbor.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudHarbor vendor onboarding — initial PO + payment terms question

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday. We're starting Redwood vendor onboarding on our side and I wanted to confirm a few items so we can issue POs and get invoices flowing.

Short list:
- What payment terms do you require for new vendors? (Net 30/45/60?)
- Do you have an early-pay/discount program if we can pay faster?
- Any specific PO number format or required fields for the invoice to be accepted by your AP system?

I've attached our completed vendor form (CloudHarbor-vendor-form.pdf) and will follow up with a W9 if needed. We're hoping to target Net45 but would like to understand early-pay options for a short runway as we onboard.

Can Kimberly or Marissa be looped in for the PO intake details on your side?

Best,
Megan Liu
Procurement Manager
CloudHarbor
attachments: CloudHarbor-vendor-form.pdf

----

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Megan Liu <megan.liu@cloudharbor.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Apr 2028 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudHarbor vendor onboarding — initial PO + payment terms question

Hi Megan — great to meet you. Appreciate the form.

Short answers up front:
- Redwood standard for new vendors is Net45.
- We do offer an EarlyPay program: typically a 1.5% discount off invoice if payment is completed within 15 days (Net15 settlement). Enrollment is subject to a brief credit/AP review; we can pilot that for the first three invoices to validate cash flow.
- PO format: your PO should include a 7-digit PO number (e.g. PO-1234567) and line-level SKU/description + total. Invoices missing a PO or with mismatched totals usually get routed to exceptions and delay payment.

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll route your vendor form to our AP intake queue and attach the Redwood vendor intake doc (Redwood-vendor-intake.pdf) — checklist there covers required fields.
2) If you'd like to join the EarlyPay pilot, confirm and we'll start the short review; our AP team needs a signed W9, tax ID, and banking remediation (ACH remit) details.
3) Kimberly will confirm the PO acceptance rules and whether we need DocuSign for the W9.

Link to the onboarding checklist: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bVendorOnboardDoc

Happy to hop on a quick 15m call if you want to walk through the checklist.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood-vendor-intake.pdf, earlypay-program-overview.pdf

----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Megan Liu <megan.liu@cloudharbor.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudHarbor vendor onboarding — initial PO + payment terms question

Thanks Sean / Megan — looping procurement intake and AP.

Megan: quick housekeeping from our side — can you confirm these items so we can close intake?
- Legal entity name exactly as it should appear on the PO/invoice
- Tax ID / W9 (PDF) — we prefer DocuSign but will accept a signed PDF for initial enrollment
- Preferred remit method (ACH preferred) + bank details or remit email for checks

I'll set the vendor record to Pending until AP validates the bank info. If you're opting into EarlyPay, mark that in the vendor form and we'll schedule the credit review.

Sean: Please add the vendor onboarding ticket to our procurement queue (PROC-3982) and include the requested docs in the ticket so AP can process.

-Marissa
Manager, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

----

From: Megan Liu <megan.liu@cloudharbor.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudHarbor AP <ap@cloudharbor.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Apr 2028 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudHarbor vendor onboarding — initial PO + payment terms question

Hi Sean / Marissa — thanks for the clear options. We would like to enroll in the EarlyPay pilot for the first three invoices (1.5% discount / Net15).

Attached: signed W9 (will upload to DocuSign by EOD) and our remit info.

A couple quick questions before you route to AP:
- Our procurement team typically uses PO numbers formatted CH-0001234. Is the leading alpha allowed or must it be numeric-only?
- For onboarding purposes, do you need a copy of our Master Services Agreement or is the vendor form + W9 sufficient to create the vendor record?

If numeric-only is required for the PO, we can configure our system to produce a numeric-only alias for Redwood. Otherwise we prefer to keep our CH- prefix.

Appreciate the help — please confirm next steps and expected timeline once AP has the docs.

Best,
Megan Liu
Procurement Manager
CloudHarbor
attachments: signed_W9_CloudHarbor.pdf, CH_remit_instructions.pdf
